eyebrow: Who read a sensitive table, last 30 days
code:
SELECT DISTINCT user_name, query_id, query_start_time
FROM SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.ACCESS_HISTORY,
     LATERAL FLATTEN(base_objects_accessed) AS f1
WHERE f1.value:"objectName"::STRING = 'ANALYTICS_DB.FINANCE.PAYROLL'
  AND query_start_time >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
ORDER BY query_start_time DESC;
caption: FLATTEN unpacks ACCESS_HISTORY's semi-structured object list so you can filter to one specific table by name.

eyebrow: Did a masking policy actually apply?
code:
SELECT query_id, query_start_time, user_name, policies_referenced
FROM SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.ACCESS_HISTORY
WHERE query_start_time >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
  AND policies_referenced IS NOT NULL;
caption: policies_referenced proves a masking or row access policy from Chapter 2 actually evaluated for that query — not just that it exists.
